picks.name: PT Musik
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New label discovery: Príncipe (Lisbon).
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Consumação" (June 5, 2026) is an 8-track EP on the Lisbon label Príncipe -- Nha Budjura, Lembranças, Coração de Pedra, Não Acredito, Leave Me Alone, Movimento, Me Suga, Hot Girl -- a transitional, spiritually-inflected document marking a break with his old self.
picks.why_listen: New material from an artist already in your rotation, and a chance to discover Príncipe -- the Lisbon label behind the Angolan-diaspora batida/kuduro sound -- through someone you already play.

picks.name: DJs Di Guetto
picks.source_note: Same label as PT Musik (above) -- Príncipe, Lisbon.
picks.bio: "DJs Di Guetto Vol. II" (March 6, 2026) is a collective LP on Príncipe written and produced by DJ Fofuxo, DJ Jesse, DJ Marfox, DJ N.K, DJ Nervoso, and DJ Pausas -- foundational names in Lisbon's ghetto/batida scene.
picks.why_listen: Raw, foundational batida/kuduro from the scene's core figures -- a good entry point into the Príncipe sound alongside your PT Musik pick above.
